positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed robust and very abstract Transportation Routing Guide to suggest optimal package and routing options to external clients.  Rule base configuration system to allow detailed customizations.
Implemented Subversion and Hudson build for better Software Development Life Cycle Management for very demanding release cycle.
Implemented and trained 7 developers for better Source Management Procedures and provided documentations to manage newly implemented source management and release manage tools.
Created MS Build Scripts for 4 different environments for 5 main applications to be triggered by Hudson CI build. 
Enhanced home grown Warehouse Management System written in C# windows form application and web-form applications.
Provide Automated Quality Control Process with Selenium IDE and nNuit.

Environment:   C# .NET 3.5 framework.  JQuery, AJAX Toolkits, Visual Studio 2008, SQL Server 2005 and SQL Server 2008,   Winodws 7.0,  Windows Server 2003.  Visual Source Safe,  Subversion, Tortois Subversion,  Hudson build, Javascript. Active Directory Integration with Hudson and Subversion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and Maintained government regulated Smokeless Tobacco Promotional website.
Developed Poll and Gift objects backend with C# and VB.NET code behind for ASP.NET. 
Worked with Flash developers with WebOrb objects to provide back-end functionality to flash presentation.
Provided SQL Store Procedures and scripts to normalized inherited data from previous vendors.
Worked with Equifax to import/export and synchronize customer data.
Worked with Web Engineers who provides presentation layer with javascript, XML and web services.
Managed Deployment process and created braches for monthly and M&E releases.
Wrote build script and create job for Hudson builds.
Automated Test Script with Selenium for easier QA process.

Environment:  Windows Server 2003, MS SQL Server 2005, Hudson, Subversion, Visual Basic .NET, C#, .NET Framework 3.5 , AJAX, HTML, CSS, Javascript, TSQL, WebService.

positions.title: Senior Systems Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as a DOC/UI developer in 40 and plus development Team. 
Worked with all levels of Development Team from Base to Release to ensure inclusion of development changes to monthly and critical release. 
Implement Web Based Commercial Insurance Policy Management Software for major Insurance companies using Visual Basic 6.0/.NET, Classic ASP, ASP.NET, XML, XLS, and Store Procedures. 
Implement UI, Rating, and Insurance related Forms and Document Management System. Work with regular and critical builds. Source Management System and mastered build related work.
Worked closely with Project Leader, QA and BA to deliver functionalities in multiple release deadline and critical patch releases.
Unit Test in three different environment (Local, Development, Test, Production) and Manages versions for final release to clients.
 
Environment:  Visual Studio, SQL Server 2000, StarTeam, XML, COM, VB6, Classic ASP, VB Script, Java script,  VB.NET, AJAX, Agile, MS Project, CSS, TSQL, SOAP, WebService, Windows Service.

positions.title: Information Management
positions.description:
Developed and sold software packages to clients in Telecommunication, import and wholesale industry. 
Developed Software includes ERP System, Telecommunication Billing System and catalog software helping customers with easy catalog generation, item management, order management, inventory and simple accounting reporting and Wireless Retail Management Software.  
Applications were mainly developed in VB, VB.NET and access database and SQL Server with third party COM objects to provide real-time image capturing and catalog template generation.  This software also provides functions to manage on-line catalog on remote virtual server. 
Hosting packages were also sold per customer's requirements.

Environment:  Windows Server 2000, 2003, MS SQL Server 2000, 2005, Visual Source Safe, Visual Basic .NET, C#, .NET Framework 1.0 , AJAX, HTML, CSS, Javascript, LDAP, Perl, Intershop,  VB6, Classic ASP, VBScript, COM, DCOM, MS Project, Crystal Report, Video Capture, Graphic Editing Components. MS Commerce Ser ver, Sybase, Oracle, TSQL, PL/SQL, XML.

positions.title: Senior E-Commerce Consultant
positions.description:
Gilson
Designed and developed Multi-Currency capable store which serves 23 different countries.
Design included online catalog features 1100 different end categories. Development includes Intershop 4.2 with Cybersource payment cartridge, custom tax application, and custom shipping configurator. Intershop 4.2 templates, Sever Side Scripting and Active Server Page were used to complete the project. 
Installed and configured all the software used in the store including Intershop 4.2, Sybase, SSL Certificate and Payment Cartridge. 
Automated real time currency rate update for 22 different countries with custom developed perl script using object-oriented feature in Perl.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Directory Submission
Developed program submits client's web sites over 200 search engines and indexes both manually and automatically. Submissions are taken place at local Window 95 clients and all the submission result data and reports are created in UNIX server for real time client reporting. Automated maintenance of product and turned it over to Operation Department. NFS, Samba, Perl and Visual Basic were used to complete this project.

Direct Email 
Designed and developed Bulk Emailing Program with distributed system. Sendmail and Socket programming are used to complete this project. MySQL was used for reporting and client database.

Intranet Enhancement.
Updated and created various reporting and order processing program for client reporting and in-house accounting.

Maintaining Email Database
Developed a program to add, delete and edit database for opt-in and opt-out process.
Maintained millions email addresses for about 250 categories. Created maintenance scripts and store procedures to clean database run by scheduled cron jobs.

Server Administration
Maintained 3 BSDI servers (production servers) with root level access. NFS, samba, crontab, group file, monitoring load and scripting to prevent fabricated visits.

META Tag Builder
Developed back-end program to send Free META Tag reinforced home pages to client. One of the free tools WebPromote Developed to assist home page owners to rank higher in major search engines. Netscape established link on their free tool page.

Environment:  Windows Server NT, Oracle, Sun Unix, HTML, CSS, JSP, JDBC, J2EE, Javascript, Perl, Intershop, BSDI UNIX, C, Java, RED HAT Linux, Slackware

positions.description:
Set up and maintained window workgroup and later upgraded to Windows 95 Networking. Set up Trading Network Connection to World Trade Center for Integration Trading Listing Services. Set up Internet Connection and started Internet Inquiry Processing Service on the WEB.  Managed sales operation including logistics and AR. Managed sales representatives for distribution of powder and bulk solid related products.
Environment:  Windows, Lotus123, HTML, Perl.
